summary.headline: Front VIX curve compressed materially; November/December carry supply dominates while moderate correction hedges remain layered.
key_points: Oct forward compressed from the prior ~17.74 area to 17.32-17.48 while VIX traded 15.48-15.91.
The -$25.0M transaction VIX delta is dominated by a November 18 synthetic-short-like / 21.5C supply package, but remains slightly negative after removing it.
Friday's October hedge monetization was strongly OI-confirmed: Oct20C -102k and Oct30C -91k, while Nov20C +96k confirms outward migration of correction exposure.
Dec35C +34k after a 35k sell confirms fresh deferred upper-tail short-call inventory; Monday adds same-side Dec35/50 call selling.
Visible Oct22C and Nov20/30 call demand preserves moderate stress protection despite broad normalization.
summary.daily_note: Current BUY/SELL is transaction-side only; Oct 5 opening/closing requires the next OI profile.

leave_one_out.comment: The dominant November center package explains almost all of the negative magnitude, but removing it leaves the session marginally negative. Removing any other single major package also leaves the headline negative.

events: Late Oct17.5 long movement vs 19C supply

structures.interpretation: Next OI strongly validates Friday's monetization/roll: Oct20C -102k, Oct30C -91k, Nov20C +96k. October correction inventory was reduced and moderate protection migrated into November.
Dec35C OI increased +34k after a ~35k sell, confirming fresh deferred upper-tail short-call inventory. January confirmation is unavailable in the filtered profile.
1x short 19P / 2x long 17P for ~0.30 credit. If opened, payoff is worst near 17 and improves above ~18.7 or below ~15.3; this is not a simple directional VIX-down bet.
Aggressive purchase of ~50k Dec15P adds deep-normalization convexity; next OI is required to distinguish fresh longs from short-put covering.
Repeated block slices sell 18C, buy 18P and sell 21.5C near a Nov forward of ~18.05. Starting OI at 21.5C is only ~558 versus very large current turnover, so fresh opening/churn is unavoidable.
Visible 22C demand is paired in time with 45C selling, consistent with paying for moderate October stress while monetizing catastrophe continuation.
Long movement around the compressed Oct forward plus extra 20C correction exposure; this is a hedge layer inside an otherwise normalizing front curve.
A clean 20/30 call debit spread continues the outward correction-hedge theme while capping extreme continuation.
Synthetic-short-like flow near the late Oct forward is reinforced by 24/29C sales; a small 23.5C purchase preserves limited correction exposure.
Synthetic-long-like December exposure near the ~18.54 forward plus 30C adds deferred correction protection.
Same-side continuation of OI-confirmed Dec35 short-call inventory with additional 50C tail sale.
